description: Ollama framework layer — streaming NDJSON TypeScript client for /api/generate with line-buffered chunk parsing.

buildHints.whenToUse: Self-hosted / local LLM inference where privacy, offline operation, or zero-vendor-cost matter. Use over cloud LLM layers when data must stay on-prem or when targeting laptops and air-gapped environments.
firstSteps: Start Ollama: `docker compose up -d` — binds port 11434 on the host. CPU-only by default; uncomment the GPU block in docker-compose.yml for CUDA.
Pull a model (one-time): `docker compose exec ollama ollama pull llama3.2` (~2-8 GB). Other options: qwen2.5, mistral, gemma3.
Install deps and run: `pnpm install && pnpm dev` — `src/client.ts` calls /api/generate and streams the response to stdout.
Customize the persona: edit `Modelfile` (FROM, SYSTEM, PARAMETER temperature/stop), then `ollama create mymodel -f Modelfile` inside the container.
Verify: `curl http://localhost:11434/api/tags` lists loaded models; `pnpm typecheck` must pass with zero errors.
gotchas: The Ollama response stream is NDJSON, not SSE — each chunk is a JSON line. The client buffers partial lines across `read()` calls; do not replace the line-split logic with a single `JSON.parse` on the raw chunk.
Models are pulled at runtime, not baked into the image. A fresh container returns an error (not a hang) for an unpulled model — always pull before calling /api/generate.
`@types/node` is required for `process.stdout.write` and `process.exit` — it is declared in this layer's packageDeps and must remain in devDependencies.
GPU inference requires both `deploy.resources.reservations.devices` in docker-compose.yml AND nvidia-container-toolkit on the host. Missing either silently falls back to slow CPU mode.
architectureNotes: Replace the example prompt in `src/client.ts` and the stdout handler with the product's actual call flow — the streaming loop and NDJSON parser are production-ready and should be kept.
For chat (multi-turn), switch the endpoint to /api/chat and pass a `messages` array instead of a flat `prompt` string; the NDJSON framing is identical.

placeholders.description: Example client calling /api/generate with a hardcoded prompt. Replace the prompt string and stdout handler with the product's actual LLM call flow. Keep the streaming loop and NDJSON parser.
